// Fixture generator for #1196 (not part of this commit's tree). Chain and
// binding strings are the ones master's own encoders wrote into the v7
// fixture, so every fixture carries the same real envelopes.
import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:segno_engine/segno_engine.dart';
import 'package:session_repository/session_repository.dart';

import 'helpers/fake_session_engine.dart';

const laneChain0 = "{\"chainEnabled\":true,\"entries\":[{\"type\":3,\"params\":[0.3,0.4,0.5,0.0],\"slotId\":\"204f9ee7-0\"},{\"type\":7,\"params\":[0.5,0.5,0.35,0.0],\"slotId\":\"204f9ee7-1\"}]}";
const laneChain1 = "{\"chainEnabled\":false,\"entries\":[{\"type\":1,\"params\":[0.5,0.8,0.0,0.0],\"slotId\":\"204f9ee7-2\"}]}";
const monitorChain0 = "{\"chainEnabled\":true,\"entries\":[{\"type\":6,\"params\":[0.45,0.5,0.35,0.0],\"slotId\":\"204f9ee7-5\"}]}";
const monitorChain1 = "{\"chainEnabled\":true,\"entries\":[]}";
const trackChain1 = "{\"chainEnabled\":true,\"entries\":[{\"type\":4,\"params\":[0.3,0.7,0.0,0.0],\"slotId\":\"204f9ee7-3\"}]}";
const busChain = "{\"chainEnabled\":true,\"entries\":[{\"type\":2,\"params\":[0.5,0.2,0.0,0.0],\"slotId\":\"204f9ee7-4\"}]}";
const bindings = "[{\"button\":\"track1\",\"bank\":0,\"target\":\"{\\\"stage\\\":\\\"loop\\\",\\\"index\\\":0,\\\"lane\\\":0}\",\"behavior\":\"toggle\"},{\"button\":\"track2\",\"bank\":0,\"target\":\"{\\\"stage\\\":\\\"master\\\",\\\"index\\\":0}\",\"behavior\":\"momentary\"}]";

Float32List pcm(int frames, double value) =>
    Float32List.fromList(List.filled(frames, value));

FakeSessionEngine seededEngine() {
  final engine = FakeSessionEngine()
    ..seedLayers(
      0,
      [pcm(2400, 0.25), pcm(2400, 0.375), pcm(2400, 0.5)],
      undoDepth: 2,
    )
    ..seedTrack(1, pcm(4800, 0.5), multiple: 2, volume: 0.5, muted: true)
    ..seedLane(1, 1, pcm(4800, 0.125), volume: 1.5, outputMask: 0x1)
    ..seedLayers(2, [pcm(2400, 0.75), pcm(2400, 0.8125)], redoDepth: 1)
    ..tempoBpm = 100
    ..tempoSource = TempoSource.manual
    ..tsNum = 3
    ..quantizeDiv = GridDivision.bar
    ..clickMode = ClickMode.rec
    ..clickMask = 0x2
    ..clickVolume = 0.8
    ..countInBars = 2
    ..looperMode = LooperMode.sync
    ..primaryTrack = 0;
  return engine;
}

String get out => Platform.environment['FIXTURE_OUT']!;

SessionRepository repoFor(AudioEngine engine) => SessionRepository(
  engine: engine,
  clearPollInterval: Duration.zero,
  clearPollAttempts: 4,
);

void main() {
  test('generate v11_trunk_5c163d11f', () async {
    await repoFor(seededEngine()).save(
      '$out/v11_trunk_5c163d11f',
      chains: SessionChains(
        laneChains: const [
        SessionLaneChain(channel: 0, lane: 0, encoded: laneChain0),
        SessionLaneChain(channel: 3, lane: 1, encoded: laneChain1),
      ],
      trackChains: const [SessionTrackChain(channel: 1, encoded: trackChain1)],
        monitors: const [
          SessionMonitor(
            input: 0,
            mode: 'auto',
            outputMask: 3,
            volume: 0.9,
            muted: false,
            encoded: monitorChain0,
          ),
          SessionMonitor(
            input: 1,
            mode: 'on',
            outputMask: 2,
            volume: 0.75,
            muted: true,
            encoded: monitorChain1,
          ),
        ],
        outputChains: const [SessionOutputChain(bus: 1, encoded: busChain)],
        allTracksChain: laneChain1,
      ),
      pedalBindings: bindings,
      settings: const SessionSettings(
        tempoBpm: 100,
        tempoSource: TempoSource.manual,
        tsNum: 3,
        syncTempo: false,
        quantizeDiv: GridDivision.bar,
        recordTiming: RecordTiming.bar,
        overdubDecay: 20,
        defaultLengthPresetBars: 4,
        trackRecordTimingOverrides: {2: RecordTiming.immediately},
        trackOverdubDecayOverrides: {1: 50},
        trackOneShotOverrides: {2: true, 5: true},
        trackLengthPresetOverrides: {1: 2},
        clickMode: ClickMode.rec,
        clickMask: 0x2,
        clickVolume: 0.8,
        countInBars: 2,
        recDub: true,
        autoRecord: true,
        defaultMultiple: 2,
        looperMode: LooperMode.sync,
        primaryTrack: 0,
        trackPans: {1: -0.25},
        laneMix: {(1, 1): (level: 1.5, imagePan: 0.5, balance: 0.75)},
        laneInputs: {(3, 0): 1},
        laneOutputs: {(3, 0): 2},
        laneCounts: {3: 2},
        inputSetup: SessionInputSetup(trimDb: {0: -3}, pairs: {0: 0.2}),
        outputSetup: SessionOutputSetup(level: {0: 0.8}, mono: {1: true}),
        trackLevels: {1: 0.7},
        defaultFadeDurationMs: 6000,
        trackFadeDurationOverrides: {1: 2500},
      ),
    );
  });
}
